chunks.arabic_text: عَلَلُ الشَّرَائِعِ: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ زِيَادِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ الْبَزَنْطِيِّ وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ

translations.en: Alal al-Shara'i: Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja'far al-Hamdani, from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti and Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

chunks.arabic_text: لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ انْهَزَمَ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ حَتَّى لَمْ يَبْقَ مَعَهُ إِلَّا عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَأَبُو دَجَانَةَ سَمَاكُ بْنُ خَرَّشَةَ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: يَا أَبَا دَجَانَةَ أَمَا تَرَى قَوْمَكَ؟ قَالَ: بَلَى. قَالَ: الْحِقْ بِقَوْمِكَ. قَالَ: مَا عَلَى هَذَا بَايَعْتُ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ. قَالَ: أَنْتَ فِي حِلٍّ. قَالَ: وَاللَّهِ لَا تَتَحَدَّثُ قُرَيْشٌ بِأَنِّي خَذَلْتُكَ وَفَرَرْتُ حَتَّى أَذُوقَ مَا تَذُوقُ. فَجَزَاهُ النَّبِيُّ خَيْرًا. وَكَانَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ كُلَّمَا حَمَلَتْ طَائِفَةٌ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ اسْتَقْبَلَهُمْ وَرَدَّهُمْ حَتَّى أَكْثَرَ فِيهِمُ الْقَتْلَ وَالْجِرَاحَاتِ حَتَّى انْكَسَرَ سَيْفُهُ. فَجَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ يُقَاتِلُ بِسِلَاحِهِ وَقَدْ انْكَسَرَ سَيْفِي. فَأَعْطَاهُ سَيْفَهُ ذَا الْفَقَارِ. فَمَا زَالَ يَدْفَعُ بِهِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ حَتَّى أَثَّرَ وَانْكَرَ. فَنَزَلَ عَلَيْهِ جِبْرِيلُ وَقَالَ: يَا مُحَمَّدُ إِنَّ هَذِهِ هِيَ الْمُوَاسَاةُ مِنْ عَلِيٍّ لَكَ. فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: إِنَّهُ مِنِّي وَأَنَا مِنْهُ. فَقَالَ جِبْرِيلُ: وَأَنَا مِنْكُمَا. وَسَمِعُوا دُوِيًّا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ لَا سَيْفَ إِلَّا ذُو الْفَقَارِ وَلَا فَتَى إِلَّا عَلِيٌّ

translations.en: On the day of Uhud, the companions of the Messenger of Allah fled until only Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) and Abu Dujana Simak ibn Kharra remained with him. The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said to him: 'O Abu Dujana, do you not see your people?' He said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Go to your people.' He said: 'I did not pledge allegiance to Allah and His Messenger for this.' He said: 'You are released [from your pledge].' He said: 'By Allah, the Quraysh will not say that I abandoned you and fled until I taste what you taste.' The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) granted him goodness. Whenever a group attacked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), Ali (peace be upon him) would face them and repel them, causing many casualties and wounds among them, until his sword broke. He came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, a man fights with his weapon, and my sword has broken.' So he gave him his sword, Dhu al-Fiqar. He continued to defend the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) with it until he was marked [with wounds] and became unrecognizable. Jibril descended and said: 'O Muhammad, this is the true support from Ali to you.' The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'He is from me and I am from him.' Jibril said: 'And I am from you both.' They heard a sound from the sky: 'There is no sword except Dhu al-Fiqar and no young champion except Ali.'

en.summary: This hadith from *Alal al-Shara'i* underscores the pivotal role of Ali ibn Abi Talib and Abu Dujana in stabilizing the Prophet's position during the chaos of Uhud, emphasizing Ali's endurance through the breaking of his own sword to receive Dhu al-Fiqar. The narrative culminates in a divine affirmation via Jibril, linking Ali's physical defense (*muwasah*) to the prophetic declaration 'I am from him and he is from me,' a key verse for Shia exegesis regarding their spiritual unity. The celestial cry 'No sword but Dhu al-Fiqar, no youth but Ali' serves as a foundational text for the unique status of Ali in Shia tradition.
en.seo_question: What happened to Ali ibn Abi Talib during the Battle of Uhud regarding his sword and status?

key_terms.أَبُو دَجَانَةَ: Abu Dujana (a companion known for bravery)
key_terms.ذُو الْفَقَارِ: Dhu al-Fiqar (the famous sword of the Prophet/Ali)
